title: Mapping lists through binary expansions
statement: For every function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and every finite list $l$ of natural numbers, mapping $l$ by $a\mapsto$ the binary expansion of $f(a)$ gives the same list of bit strings as first mapping $l$ by $f$ and then taking each binary expansion.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers
$l$ is a finite list of natural numbers
